source: Curated, vetted subset of the tomnomnom/gf pattern idiom and community Gf-Patterns. Each pattern file uses gf's native format — {"flags": "HnriP", "patterns": [...]} — so the same files can be dropped into ~/.gf/ and used with the real gf binary. The flags select PCRE (P) and case-insensitive (i) matching, which both grep -P and Python re honor.

patterns.name: xss
patterns.purpose: Reflected and DOM XSS sinks: DOM write primitives fed by location/input, eval-like sinks, inline handlers, and reflection parameters.

patterns.name: ssrf
patterns.purpose: Server-side fetch sinks and URL/path-taking parameters that may drive an outbound request.

patterns.name: redirect
patterns.purpose: Open-redirect parameters and redirect sinks. Low on their own; high when chained into an OAuth flow.

patterns.name: sqli
patterns.purpose: SQL syntax fragments and query-building sinks reached by request input.

patterns.name: lfi
patterns.purpose: File include/read sinks, traversal sequences, and file/path-taking parameters.

patterns.name: rce
patterns.purpose: Command-execution sinks reached by request input.

patterns.name: ssti
patterns.purpose: Template-engine evaluation sinks and template syntax markers.

patterns.name: idor
patterns.purpose: Object-reference shapes: numeric/UUID ids in paths and id-bearing parameter names.

patterns.name: upload
patterns.purpose: File-upload forms and server-side upload sinks.

patterns.name: s3-buckets
patterns.purpose: Cloud storage bucket references: S3, GCS, Azure Blob, CloudFront, DigitalOcean Spaces, R2.
